name: Phoenix City Council November 2025 Semiconductor Apprenticeship Agenda Item 36
update_frequency: One-time council agenda with later program reporting
known_limitations: Agenda Item 36 records active cohort counts, program partners, funding support, and proposed reporting requirements. It does not report apprenticeship completion, credential attainment, retention, placement, wages, later job performance, or workforce sufficiency relative to fab and supplier demand.
source_owner: City of Phoenix Community and Economic Development Department
automation_notes: Track RAPIDS or partner reporting for completions, credentials, retention, placement, and later cohorts. Do not treat funded enrollment or reporting requirements as completed outcomes.
notes: Phase 51C workforce-program follow-through. The November 19, 2025 agenda says the first eight-person Facilities Technician cohort began in April 2024 and a second cohort included 10 Process, 18 Manufacturing, and 18 Facilities Technicians.
